Lemma
[Potential equation] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0126 1. Lemma 5.12\group normalized-ricci-flow

For a solution $g(t)$ of the normalized Ricci flow on a compact surface with curvature potential $f$, \[ \frac{\partial f}{\partial t}=\Delta f + r f. \]
